notes:
# v1.3.45 — ranks, EXP and titles, plus a new milestone rail

- New: the Account screen's Milestones panel is rebuilt as a progression view.
  Your current rank now leads with a spotlight — emblem, rank name, how much EXP
  is left to the next rank, and a progress bar — and the ranks below are a
  swipeable, snap-to-centre rail of medals. Unlocked medals pop in and glow in
  their tier colour, and the current rank gently pulses.
- New: EXP. Reading a chapter now earns a 1–5 EXP roll (3 is the most common
  result) plus a streak bonus of +1 EXP for every 7 consecutive days, up to +5.
  Ranks are measured in EXP instead of chapters, on a longer nine-tier ladder
  from 100 up to 50,000 EXP, with new tiers beyond Mythic: Radiant, Astral and
  Eternal.
- New: equippable titles. Unlock cosmetic titles by reaching a rank or a reading
  streak — Newcomer, Night Owl, Devoted Reader, Speedreader, Marathoner,
  Completionist, Insomniac, Mythic and Eternal — and show one next to your rank
  with the new "Equipped Title" dropdown.
- New: three more naming themes (Pirate, Mecha and Dungeon), and the existing
  themes gain higher rank names so every theme covers all nine tiers.
- Removed: the Goals section in the Milestones panel — the chapter and weekly
  goals with their inputs and progress bars are gone.
- Fixed: your level now follows the EXP you have earned, and syncing carries
  your total EXP between devices, so a level earned on one device is never lost.
- Note: existing readers keep their progress — older reading history is given a
  one-time, stable EXP value so totals stay meaningful.
